product_metadata.title: Copco Basics Drawer Organizer, 12.81 x 3.81 x 2.1-Inches, White/Charcoal Gray
features: SMART STORAGE: organize kitchenware, office or crafting supplies, personal care products, and more
EASY ACCESS: keeps items neat, tidy, and simple to find
NONSLIP: liner prevents items from moving and soft feet keep organizer in place when opening and closing drawers
VERSATILE: use in kitchen or throughout the home
description: Keep kitchenware, office or crafting supplies, personal care products and more, neat, tidy, and easily accessible with the Copco Basics Drawer Organizer. The separate sections allow you to sort items by size or category. The nonslip liner prevents items from moving and the soft feet keep organizer in place when opening and closing drawers. Use in kitchen or throughout the home to keep items organized and easy to find. Fits most standard-sized drawers. Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Measures 12.81 x 3.81 x 2.1 inches. .
